direction freely; ratchet_check.py fails when any metric regresses past
coverage_floor is measured on the fast selection (`pytest -m 'unit or
contract' --cov=attackmap`) and wired as --cov-fail-under in CI (AR010).
ruff_total counts `ruff check .` violations repo-wide with the pyproject
The ruff count fell from the plan's 1092 to 383 because AR003/AR006/

21% is the first-ever measured coverage for the fast selection: the floor
is deliberately conservative (it was captured on a run with the known
timing-noise failures) and is expected to ratchet upward.
